item.description: The Commonwealth and state governments say the future of the Bell Bay Aluminium smelter has been secured, with a power deal reached and a $200 financial package announced.

item.title: ABC News: Slower au pair visa approvals hit Australian families
item.description: Australian families who rely on au pairs are facing ongoing uncertainty amid working holiday visa processing delays.

item.title: ABC News: 'Friends won't be there': Fighting to save Pasifika youth from lives of crime
item.description: As Sydney's gangland wars continue there is a movement to save more Pacific Islander youths from joining gangs.

item.title: ABC News: Calls from mortgage-stressed home owners double as pressures pile up
item.description: A free Victorian service that helps home owners facing mortgage stress has been forced to temporarily close its books, as interest rate rises and inflation bite.

item.title: ABC News: Push for big tech to pay for Australian-made AI
item.description: Union figures and leading academics want big tech companies building Australian data centres to help fund the local AI industry through a levy.

item.title: ABC News: Big pharma move to dispense GLP-1s to your door condemned by doctors
item.description: Doctors and pharmacists have criticised Eli Lilly's new online platform LillyDirect that will dispense certain medicines, starting with Mounjaro, directly to a patient's door.

item.title: ABC News: Tom Cruise goes full clown in Digger. It might be his best work yet
item.description: Tom Cruise is almost unrecognisable under piles of prosthetics as Digger Rockwell, but his performance isn't the most shocking aspect of the searing satire.

item.title: ABC News: A new Green layer of difficulty could compound Labor's inflation woes
item.description: As political pressure mounts from the left and right, the risk is that pursuing more short-term relief will only make the government's long-term challenge harder.

item.title: ABC News: Shoebridge to woo same angry voters as One Nation — but from the left
item.description: David Shoebridge wants to hold Labor's feet to the fire. He will be a thorn in Labor's side rather than a deal maker.

item.title: ABC News: Credit card surcharges end today but customers will pay in other ways
item.description: There are some big changes coming for credit and debit card holders, but not all of it is good news. Here's what you need to know and how it could affect you.

item.title: ABC News: Quiz: How well do you know these fictional places in pop culture?
item.description: Think you know some of the made-up places where popular books, films and television shows are set? Let's test your knowledge.

item.title: ABC News: Russia launches major attack on Ukraine's energy grid as winter looms
item.description: Emergency power cuts are in operation and some public transport systems are suspended after heavy strikes across the country.

item.title: ABC News: US appeals court pauses execution of Tennessee killer Christa Pike
item.description: The execution, which was halted an hour before it was scheduled to go ahead, would have been the first time a woman had been subjected to the death penalty in more than 200 years.

item.title: ABC News: Breaking: 'Strong indications' Iran involved in RAF airbase incident, UK prime minister says
item.description: In an interview with the BBC, Andy Burnham says UK authorities "believe Iran to have played a part" in the plot that unfolded over the weekend near a vital UK air base.

item.title: ABC News: Israel to 'ramp up' aviation security after pilot 'tries to crash plane'
item.description: Benjamin Netanyahu says a commercial flight with 174 people on board bound for Tel Aviv had to divert to Saudi Arabia after one pilot stabbed the other and "apparently tried to crash the plane".
